NAME: DrmVncServer
DESCRIPTION: Mirrors the Force's native screen over VNC (port 5900). Start only after MPC has fully booted and claimed the display - starting it too early (e.g. via Autolaunch) can crash-loop MPC. Prefer this Start/Stop toggle over Autolaunch. Device paths below (-f/-t/-k) are fixed at the values probed on this Force on 2026-09-25; if you ever reconnect the touchscreen/keyboard differently or they enumerate as different /dev/input/eventN nodes after a firmware update, edit this file's ARGUMENTS or just run 'vncdrm START' over SSH instead, which detects them fresh every time.
